Interface CrossConnects

All Known Implementing Classes:
CrossConnectsImpl
public interface CrossConnects
Client interface for ordering cross-connects in the Equinix Customer Portal.

Backed by the Cross Connect v2 order API at /colocations/v2/orders/crossConnects. Cross-connects are ordered, updated and deinstalled as orders; the resulting order is tracked through Orders and OrderHistory. Each operation returns the generated order id (parsed from the Location response header).
